note: The one home of the field guide's numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Book: the guide spread, and the Book's face spread). Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels. Decided with the owner (2026-10-09): the guide is the Book's fold-out second spread, turned with ◀ ▶, and ← reads Library; eight chapters fit by narrower columns, never a scroll; one shared header panel per chapter, tinted by the species; the face is a guide-face master; the progress pips come in groups of five. Every field is bound to the M5 rules in prototypes/station/src/library.mjs (`derived`): nothing here is new state. The build draws only rectangles, text and 1 px lines; every other mark is a master placed 1:1 (masters).
level: species: the Book, the guide and the Library are about the species, filled in by every pod and mibi the player has read (fieldGuide). Pods and Habitat show one individual. station-layouts.md, The two levels
status: L: the Library spread (lvgl-switch.md §3, slot 5) builds `spread`; the Book's face spread and the guide spread (`regions`, `focus`, `bottomLine`) are slot 8, the Book and the field guide

screens.book: the face spread and the guide spread: everything outside `spread`

spread.note: The Library's whole, its overview level (station-layouts.md, The screen map): one frame a species, every species at once. Written by the UI designer, 2026-10-10 01:50, from the decided spread (SP-P-r4-a1, decisions.md 2026-10-08), the Station's structure (2026-10-09 17:29), the world brief (Library: the field journal the device keeps, paper and ink held in the same frame) and the rules on main (library.mjs spread, speciesStatus, faceOf, fieldGuide; intents/library.mjs). Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the frame's own place.
spread.purpose: the whole collection at a glance: which species the player has found (a painted plate), which they have only met (a pencil study), and that empty frames remain (no cue of what waits); each found or met species' clan by its inked rule, a portrait by the gilt corner, a full guide by the seal; ✓ opens that species' Book

conditions.empty: every frame unmet (a fresh world): the stage alone, sixteen empty frames, the ring on the first; capture library-spread-empty
conditions.filled: at least one frame found or met; capture library-spread

derived.frames: spread(st, ids) (library.mjs) over ids = frameIds().slice(16 × page, 16 × page + 16): sixteen { id, status }, status found, met or unmet (speciesStatus). Today frameIds() holds sixteen species, so there is one spread and page is 0
derived.place: the species' own place, never the order it was found: item i of the spread (frameIds order) sits on the left page for i < 8, the right page otherwise, at k = i mod 8 in its page's list (places.grid: k mod 4 along the row, floor(k / 4) the row). S01 to S04 the left page's top row, S05 to S08 its second, S09 to S12 the right page's top row, S13 to S16 its second
derived.name: frame.species.name, as written; found and met only
derived.clan: the clan's anchor colour: the species' first pod pigment (frameOf(id).pod.colourPair[0].pigment) through cross.json colours.pigmentChips to a palette name; a pigment not listed is `mist`. The same colour the guide's panels take (regions.panel.tint); found and met only
derived.portrayed: faceOf(st, id) is not null: a portrait of a mibi of this species is the Book's face. Found only (a portrayed mibi makes the species found)
derived.complete: fieldGuide(st, id).complete: every look of the species found. Found only
derived.lastOn: the ring's frame is kept in the Library's UI state (ui.lib.i, intents/library.mjs), so the Library key and Home's Library module land where the player left it, and ← from the Book lands on that species (openBook sets it)

stage.untilNote: while the master is unsigned its labelled placeholder is placed (placeholders), never the flat ground: the empty frames and the pages are the screen's message

parts._note: painted into the stage slice, never drawn by the build: screen rects, so the painter and the checks know where each sits
parts.frames: the sixteen empty ruled frames, each 96×112 at the places of leftPage and rightPage, with its 8 px mat and nothing in it
parts.captionRules: one 1 px rule under each frame, 96 wide, at y 256 (row 1) and y 440 (row 2), from the frame's x
parts.markerNote: the cloth marker over the gutter, centred on x 512, 4 px off the grid as a region centred on an axis may be
parts.around: the 8 px between the stage's edge and the boards: the device's own panel the volume is held in (art director)

stage.keepClear: nothing painted in the slice crosses a frame's place, its clan rule's row (y 100 to 104 and 284 to 288), its name's box or the corner and seal places: the margin life and the marker keep to their rects

item._note: one frame of spreadPage, offsets from its place (x, y, 96, 112). The ruled frame and its mat are the stage's; the build adds only what the status gives, in this order

plate.note: the focal thing: the only colour on the page

clanRule.note: the clan's inked rule over the frame (decided 2026-10-08): y 100 on row 1, 284 on row 2; 8 px of paper between it and the frame. Never on an unmet frame

name.fit: the widest of the sixteen, Untuva, is 53 px at 16: 21 px clear a side. A wider name comes back to the UI designer; never clipped, never shrunk
name.note: on the caption rule: y 232 to 252 on row 1, 416 to 436 on row 2; the rule at y 256 and 440 is the stage's

gilt.note: centred on the frame's top right corner; it meets the clan rule's end and the plate's corner, overlapping neither

seal.note: centred on the frame's bottom right corner; clear of the plate and of the name's box, 8 px from the next frame

item.unmet: nothing: the stage's empty frame alone, no name, no rule, no mark, no cue of what waits (decisions.md 2026-10-08)
item.liftNote: on paper nothing lifts: the plates are tipped into the page and the frames are printed; the ring alone marks the focus

focus.initial: derived.lastOn; with nothing kept (a fresh world), frame.S01, the first frame

frame.box: the frame's place (leftPage or rightPage rects)
frame.every: all sixteen frames, found, met or unmet: an empty frame is a place too, and the ring walks the grid without holes

focus.graphNote: ◀ ▶ along the row and across the gutter to the other page's same row; ▲ ▼ between the two rows of a page; the edges stop, never a wrap (lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1, nearestIn ahead: the frame more than 6 px ahead with the least 5 × along + 11 × across on doubled centres)

keys.confirm: a found or met frame: the Book of that species (intent target `sp:<SNN>`, events.open); an unmet frame: no ✓ cap, and the press shows the message plate strings.unmet (intents/library.mjs), nothing opens
keys.back: Home, with the ring on Home's Library module
keys.library: the spread, the ring where it was (derived.lastOn); from the Book, the spread with the ring on that species
keys.home: Home, the ring on the room
keys.dock: as on every screen: a world event; docking lands on Home

open.note: ✓ on a found or met frame. Until slot 8 the Book draws "not built yet" (frame.json notBuilt) with ← Library. The old "the plate lifts off the page and becomes the Book's mounted plate" is withdrawn: it would enlarge an 80×96 plate to the 304×312 face (station-layouts.md, Never upscaled); the Book's own entry is slot 8's to design

back.note: ← Library from either spread of the Book: the spread, the ring on that species' frame

strings._note: the copywriter's slots. Today's words come from the old spread section (Open, an empty frame) and from intents/library.mjs (the plate); none is new. Slot rules: the action a verb phrase of four words or fewer, the subject six words or fewer with no digits, the plate one sentence
strings.title: Library
strings.unmet: Nothing is known of this frame yet

never: a digit or a count on the spread (no "4 of 16", no "1 of 2")
a cue on an unmet frame: no silhouette, no shape, no name, no rule
hatching for met: the pencil study says it
a rule thicker than 1 px but the clan rule
a plate or study enlarged: rendered at 80×96 or downsampled
a word in the stage slice

turn.pending: more than sixteen species (a second spread): the page-turn corner book-corner-turn-24x24 at (968, 512, 24, 24) when another spread follows, ▶ past the right page's last column turning it (300 ms), and ◀ past the left page's first column turning back. Not built in slot L: frameIds() holds sixteen

masters._note: placed 1:1 at these sizes, never scaled or recoloured; the art director signs them under the world brief. None is made or commissioned by this spec
masters.library-stage-spread-1024x522: new. The stage: the field journal open across it, held in the device's panel; the boards (8, 8, 1008, 504 of the slice), two pages and the gutter, the sixteen empty ruled frames with their mats, the caption rules, the margin life in its two bands, the cloth marker over the gutter (stage.parts). No plates, no rules over frames, no words
masters.spread-plate-{SNN}-80x96: new, sixteen (S01 to S16). The found plate: the species' type, tipped in, painted at Pip's craft, rendered at 80×96 or downsampled, never enlarged
masters.spread-study-{SNN}-80x96: new, sixteen. The met study: a pencil field study of the species, grey line on the paper
masters.spread-gilt-corner-16x16: new. The gilt corner of a portrayed species, centred on the frame's top right corner
masters.spread-seal-16x16: new. The seal of a complete guide at the spread's size, kin to guide-seal-32 (painted at 16 or downsampled from it, never enlarged)

placeholders._note: labelled stand-ins the build places until each master is signed; entered in the placeholder register at these sizes
placeholders.library-stage-spread-1024x522: flat: the stage in `ground`, the boards in `bark`, each page `paper` with a 1 px `clay` edge, each frame a 1 px `bark` outline with a `sand` mat band 8 px inside, the caption rules 1 px `clay`; the margin bands and the marker as 1 px dashed `clay` outlines; labelled "spread stage, placeholder" in the bottom margin
placeholders.spread-plate-{SNN}-80x96: the species' placeholder render (the type specimen), downsampled to 80×96; the accepted Pip for S01
placeholders.spread-study-{SNN}-80x96: the index pass in `stone` line on `paper`
placeholders.spread-gilt-corner-16x16: a 16×16 `gold` L, 4 px thick, along the top and right edges
placeholders.spread-seal-16x16: a 16×16 `rust` disc with a 1 px `bark` edge

buildChanges.when: slot 5, L: the Library spread, in the build's own change: the sandbox reads frame.json navigation (nav.mjs parentOf and backWord, host.mjs), so the spec PR leaves it as it is

spread.journey: library-spread (lvgl-switch.md §3, slot 5): Home's Library module and the Library key open the spread; the pad walks the frames by focus.vectors; an unmet frame has no ✓ cap and its press shows strings.unmet; ✓ on a found frame reaches the Book ("not built yet" until slot 8), whose ← lands on that frame; ← on the spread is Home

spreads.face: the Book's first spread: the species' face (or a portrait), its name, habit and clarity line, places, frame plate, stamp, tree and pinned wish
spreads.guide: the fold-out second spread: every chapter as a column, every trait as a cell with its pips, one detail band. Only when book(st, id).guide is not null (the species is found); a met species has no guide and no page-turn corner
spreads.turn: ▶ from the face spread's right-most target turns to the guide (300 ms page turn); ◀ from the guide's left-most column turns back. ◀ ▶ otherwise move the ring inside the spread
spreads.back: Library on both spreads (frame.json navigation.screens.book); it lands on the Library spread with the ring on this species' frame (spread.events.back)
spreads.entry: the face spread opens from the Library spread's ✓ on a found or met frame (spread.events.open); the guide spread from the jumps (elsewhere)

derived.book: book(st, id): status, guide, face, wish
derived.guide: fieldGuide(st, id, settings): chapters[] in frame order, each { id, name, sealed, traits[] { id, name, possible, found, unseen, more } }; complete; found; unseen
derived.pips: one pip per entry of trait.possible (possibleLooks: the frame's own player words); filled for each of trait.found, unseen for the rest. A shut sealed chapter (chapter.sealed) shows no traits, and its looks count as unseen
derived.plates: the detail band's plates: trait.found in the order of trait.possible, then one dashed "more?" slot when trait.more
derived.carriers: the mibis that carry a look: st.mibis of the species, not released, whose read chapters (m.read) hold the trait's chapter and whose chapterLooks(frame, chapter, m.genome) give the look for the trait. The same test wishCarriers applies to pinned looks, generalised to any look; the builder exports it from library.mjs as a pure function beside wishCarriers (lookCarriers(st, id, traitId, look)), reading the save only. Pods are not listed: they are pods, not yours to visit
derived.wishMark: wishOf(st, id)[trait.id]: the trait cell carries wish-mark-12, and the plate of that look carries it too
derived.wishAction: wishPinBlock(st, id, traitId, look) empty: ✓ Add to the wish (wishPin); the look already pinned: ✓ Take it off the wish (wishUnpin)
derived.notice: wishCarriers(st, id).pods not empty: "a pod carries your wish"; otherwise none
derived.visit: a carrier name: ✓ Visit {mibi}, the frame's jump book → habitat; on Habitat ← reads Home
derived.face: faceOf(st, id): null shows the guide face and the type line; a mibi id shows its portrait line (released when the mibi is released)
derived.faceVisit: the face spread's ✓ Visit {mibi}: only when faceOf(st, id) is a living mibi (mibiById(st, faceOf(st, id)) not released). The type face (faceOf null) and a released portrait have no ✓ cap. Ruled by the UI designer, 2026-10-09: replaces visitTarget(st, id), which also fell back to any living mibi of the species
derived.tint: the species' first pod pigment, frame.pod.colourPair[0].pigment, through cross.json colours.pigmentChips to a palette name; a pigment not listed tints `mist`

foldout.standIn: the edge box (24, 56, 976, 488) is only the registered stand-in for library-foldout-1008x504 while that master is unsigned; once it is signed the master is placed 1:1 and the box goes
foldout.note: one sheet across the gutter: the fold-out has no gutter and no cloth marker

face.note: the species' type, head and shoulders, painted from the type specimen at 128×112; never the halo, never scaled from the Book's 304×312 face

names.fit: at most two name lines, each inside x 448 to 568. When the names overflow, drop names from the end until the kept names and "and more" fit, "and more" ending line 2 with no comma before it; never a third line

carried.note: each name is a focus target; "and more" is not

sevenOrMore.moreNote: the dashed "more?" slot keeps the word whole: 56 wide, 40 tall, after the last plate

plates.slots: derived.plates; at most 11 today (ten looks and "more?")
plates.slice: trait-{SNN}-{trait}-{look}-56x56 or -40x40, rendered at its size

more.dashNote: dashed: a 1 px clay edge, 2 px on and 2 px off

keyline.on: every look plate, at 56 and at 40
keyline.always: drawn by the build whether or not the plate's master is signed
keyline.gaps: 1 px of paper between the keyline and the open rule (the keyline's last row y + h, paper y + h + 1, the rule from y + h + 2) and between the keyline and the ring (paper at outset 2)
keyline.why: bark, because clay means open state

plates.open: the look the carried line names: the plate under the ring, or the last one it was on; on arrival the pinned look, else the first found. A 2 px `clay` rule 2 px under that plate (rows y + h + 2 and y + h + 3); the ring on that plate may cover it

columns.moreThanEight: comes back to the UI designer; never a scroll
columns.x0: floor((512 - (pitch × n - 8) / 2) / 8) × 8: 40 for seven, 32 for eight, 240 for four

rules.x: x0 + pitch × i - 4 for i from 1

tint.lattice: inside the panel, from its own origin: every pixel with (px mod 4, py mod 4) = (0, 0) or (2, 2), for py from 3 to 78 and px from 1 to w - 2: one pixel in eight
tint.ruleNote: a 2 px band across the top inside the edge, in the full tint, the Library's inked clan-rule idiom

panel.master: placed 1:1 over the tint: the edge, the paper grain at low alpha and the chapter's ink emblem 40×40 at (w / 2 - 20, 8); its ground is open so the tint shows through; never recoloured

word.text: pods.json strings.legsTail.heading for legs-tail; otherwise the frame's chapters[].name as written; the build never recases

sealed.master: guide-panel-sealed-{w}x80: slats and an 8×4 notch cut at the bottom centre

pips.widest: ten looks: 84 px, inside the 112 column

open.note: the trait shown in the detail band; the ring is the only highlight on top of it

cell.rows: at most six today (S09 Coat): the sixth row ends at y 504

faceSpread._note: the Book's first spread keeps its accepted layout (station-layouts.md, Book) with these changes

clarityLine.centreNote: centred on the face plate: x 180 on the build stub's plate (30, 60, 300, 330), x 200 once the M5 face spread lands

cut: the stub's "clan ... · n chapters" line under the name (180, 440): dropped, not moved
faceSpread.rightPage: the tabs and the trait rows go to the guide spread; the stamp label (832, 112), the family tree (800, 248) and the pinned wish (800, 424) stay

stamp.source: frame.typeSpecimen's stamp, with no mibi name under it, until a portrait; then the portrayed mibi's
stamp.note: at its spec rect, never the stub's 112 at (886, 406)

standIn.when: book(st, id).guide is not null, while book-corner-turn-24x24 is unsigned

focus.initial: the first trait cell of the first chapter that is not sealed; the same after a jump into the guide

grid.up: the cell above; from the first row, the detail's first plate
grid.down: the cell below, stopping at the column's last
grid.left: the same row in the previous column that is not sealed, clamped to its last row; from the first column, the page turns back to the face spread
grid.right: the same row in the next column that is not sealed, clamped; from the last column, nothing

detail.left: the previous plate, then the carrier names from the last
detail.right: the next plate; from the last, nothing

focus.ring: frame.focus.ring in its onPaper colour (rust), the same geometry

masters._note: placed 1:1 at these sizes, never scaled or recoloured; the art director signs them. All new unless marked existing
masters.library-foldout-1008x504: the fold-out sheet: the boards and one page across the gutter, aged paper, no gutter, no marker
masters.guide-panel-{chapter}-128x80: one per chapter, shared by every species: coat, face, shape, legs-tail, movement, stamina, character, glow, charge (9). Edge, faint grain, the ink emblem 40×40 at (44, 8); open ground for the tint
masters.guide-panel-{chapter}-112x80: the same nine at the eight-chapter width, the emblem at (36, 8); painted at 112, never cut from the 128
masters.guide-panel-sealed-128x80: a shut panel: slats and an 8×4 notch at the bottom centre; no tint
masters.guide-face-{SNN}-128x112: one per species (S01 to S16): the type specimen, head and shoulders, painted at 128×112 on the plate's own ground with its mount
masters.book-corner-turn-24x24: 24×24: the face spread's page-turn corner at (968, 512), only when the species has a guide; the art director signs it. Until signed, the build's stand-in is a 16 px bark ▶ centred in the slot
masters.wish-mark-12: 12×12: a pinned look, on a trait cell and its plate
masters.wish-mark-24: 24×24: the pinned wish panel's corner on the face spread

masters.trait-{SNN}-{trait}-{look}-40x40: the same at 40, for seven slots or more

buildDraws: rect (the panel ground, the tint lattice pixel by pixel, the top band, found pips, the open edges, the open plate's rule, the look plates' 1 px bark keyline), text (the page-turn stand-in ▶ while its master is unsigned) and 1 px lines (the dashed more? edge; the fold-out's edge box while its master is unsigned); nothing else

a look the guide does not hold
a pod in the carried line
a scroll or a second row of columns
the halo as the guide's face
the tint on a sealed panel
